applicabilityBasis.summary: Streamex describes GLDY as a gold-backed tokenized security issued by its Cayman Islands fund. Its June 2026 Form 10-Q identifies GLDY tokens as non-voting participating equity interests in Streamex Ltd.; the current product page markets the token to accredited investors. These fund equity interests support the GENIUS section 2(22)(B)(iii) securities exclusion.

genius.notes: GLDY is outside GENIUS payment-stablecoin tracking because the issuer describes it as a tokenized security and its Form 10-Q identifies the tokens as participating equity interests in a Cayman Islands entity. The gold-price exposure and gold-leasing returns are separately disclosed. This is an applicability exclusion, not GENIUS authorization. issuerEntity remains unchanged as Streamex, Ltd.; the privacy notice explicitly names that legal issuer and its Cayman Islands incorporation.
